notes:
T952 (moving-parts gate false positive on external harness caffeinate): RESOLVED + verified.

1. ROOT CAUSE & DEFECT:
   - T943 introduced tools/regression-moving-parts.sh to enforce moving-parts inventory and process hygiene.
   - The process scanner checked `if 'caffeinate' in cmd` across the entire host process tree without checking project ancestry.
   - When an interactive Claude Code console (`claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`) or similar agent harness is open, it runs a background `caffeinate -i -t 300` to prevent host sleep. Because it used -i -t rather than -w <pid>, Arm A (the null control) failed on a clean host whenever a console was open, breaking zig build test.

2. FIX & SCOPE (ATTRIBUTION BY ANCESTRY):
   - Updated tools/moving-parts-scanner.py in tools/regression-moving-parts.sh to inspect process ancestry (has_project_ancestor).
   - A caffeinate process is attributed as project-owned only if it references project paths or has a project process in its ancestor chain.
   - External agent harness caffeinates (e.g. Claude Code console or Pi running outside project scripts) have no project ancestry and are documented as EXEMPT (not ours).
   - Project-spawned timed caffeinates (-i -t) in test trees or scripts remain strictly PROHIBITED and flagged.
   - Legitimate project caffeinate sidecars (caffeinate -i -w <pid> under tools/runner or goban-scaling-capture.sh) remain documented and allowed.
   - Added .zig-cache/.*build\b and claude -p / pi --provider patterns to ALLOWED_PATTERNS so zig build runner and active worker processes under runner are recognized cleanly during zig build test.
   - Documented the exempt harness caffeinate row in docs/infra/moving-parts.md table and updated the Sleep Guard Discipline policy.

3. CONTROLS & VERIFICATION:
   - Live null control (Arm A): passes cleanly on a live host with active consoles and background tasks (RC=0).
   - Seeded defect & ancestry discrimination (Arm C):
     * Live test: spawns caffeinate -i -t 30 under project script -> caught and flagged in prohibited_caffeinate (RC=1).
     * Synthetic test: compares identical command shape caffeinate -i -t 300 under Claude harness (exempt, passes) vs under project test script (caught and flagged) vs project runner caffeinate -i -w <pid> (documented, passes) -> verified discrimination by ancestry.
   - zig build test reaches tools/regression-moving-parts.sh and passes all controls (129/146 steps passed, moving-parts green).

Acceptance: `sh tools/regression-moving-parts.sh` ALL CONTROLS PASSED.
